g.text: Zero-heap ANSI C99 & ESP32 nodes streaming encrypted Cauchy-FEC packet trains
across 20% packet loss, bursty marine RF fades, and dual 4G CGNAT links (necklink).
ROS 2 Jazzy + MOOS-IvP survey vessels, CUDA 512-beam sonar gridding, YOLOv11m
maritime vision, NOAA spectral wave forecasters & Alphasense gas physics.
167k to 1.67M spiking Drosophila CNS neurons in custom CUDA/Triton kernels
with plastic Mushroom-Body memory vaults and closed-loop MuJoCo 3D locomotion.
